checks.description: Sourced extensible catalog and explicit defaults/unknowns
Deterministic protected sensor-only and full inactive config output
Generation-aware bounded atomic draft/candidate publication and recovery
Structured accessible user journey and privilege transitions
Exact additive package staging and existing host regression
Real authenticated installed configuration journey with outputs inactive

constraints.text: Catalog evidence must distinguish documented reference, inferred, owner-entered and measured/installed-match facts. Deliver SV08 main/tool and exact pinned Octopus non-Pro/EBB v1.2 references and component choices; preserve the Octopus Pro v1.1 heater warning. Audit each selectable connector/contact/capability/reserved pin/channel count against primary source with revision/path/page/access date; unknown facts remain unknown and cannot enable unsupported assignments. Sample configuration is not a complete connector/electrical rating inventory or hardware compatibility certificate. Factory curves must retain the two exact vendor point sets, explicit curve origins and reference pull-ups, without claiming sensor identity or measured resistor values.

Preserve incomplete draft/save/export and explicitly selected provisional inactive candidates with physical evidence gaps. Generation requires mode-specific software completeness, not heated calibration or universal installed board identification. Sensor-only generation must positively allow only named MCU transports, kinematics none, temperature_sensor, the two fixed factory thermistor definitions and approved empty-action inputs; reject every output section, macro, arbitrary include/text and injection. Full complete SV08 fixtures must cover CoreXY/four-Z and selected components with upstream heater protection retained; missing geometry/current/control facts cause field blockers. Parse with pinned Klipper and matching dictionaries; evidence remains offline syntax only. Apply cannot alter live printer.cfg, services, MCU/host state or outputs.

Resolve boot.json, Store registry and actual generation/config view consistently under Store exclusion before the feature lock; reject trial/unknown/mismatched context and unexpected owned-path links. Use bounded nonblocking acquisition. Save CAS and review/apply identity must bind draft, catalog, generator, mode, current candidate and generation context, revalidated under lock. Prove stale tabs/reviews, generation change, lost acknowledgment, privilege loss, cancel/disconnect and concurrent writers preserve prior complete state. Publication must durably commit draft/current/previous coherently, with killed-process/no-space/corruption/schema-downgrade tests and actual Store generation copy/rollback tests; no mock-only persistence acceptance.

Enforce 128KiB structured draft/import, 64 attachments, 512KiB generated bundle and 4MiB feature storage including temporary publication space; count filesystem blocks/inodes and abandoned temporary files. Preserve corrupt/unsupported originals and never silently reset/migrate. Files0600 and private owned directory, no wider config ownership changes or sensitive values in logs/URLs/localStorage. Test both current Store/Budget and historical installed pre-Budget Store APIs with accepted reserve/copy behavior. A narrow feature-local compatibility path may use existing APIs; do not broadly refresh Store/runtime or introduce a generic allocation platform. Report root/data payload and factory 8GB impact without weakening shared reserves/recovery/idle admission.

Keep the finite separate sv08-printer Cockpit package/helper and one host navigation delta, existing Shell and host RPC/session behavior. Demonstrate second-package navigation/session authority using selected Cockpit337; an actual incompatibility requires concrete evidence before a smaller supported alternative. No new authentication, permission tokens, daemon, dependencies, executable catalog plugins or upstream modifications. Fresh-root and exact-preimage additive overlay inventories must cover installed historical API closure, file modes, new package allowance, beforeimages and bounded restoration; reject unexpected preimages and keep recovery/diagnostic assemblies inert. Preserve accepted printer-controls include ownership rather than duplicating/reimplementing that workflow.

Before delivery acceptance provide named evidence levels: offline catalog/validation, pinned file-output, actual disposable Store generations and browser fixture journeys, then actual authenticated installed ARM64 Cockpit/helper evidence on the named host. Compare absent workflow with board/device selection, connector/pin display, defaults, incomplete draft/reopen, board-change clearing, review/cancel/apply inactive, import/export/prior-candidate restoration, Stop/logout and keyboard/touch1024x600/desktop. Observe root restored ro and unchanged masks/live printer.cfg. Independent software verification and exact installation review precede coordinator installation; this proposal grants no hardware operation or sensor-session activation. Reuse valid A/B evidence without demanding a new full VM/physical A-B campaign; H01/H05/H06 and all H12 completion/exclusions remain intact.

decision.rationale: The direct owner request authorizes the structured installed component workflow within docs/project.md and decisions0006/0010; no additional product permission is needed. Current ui/host/index.html and finite sv08_admin.py have no component catalog/generator, so this is useful nonduplicate work; accepted printer-interface-config supplies separate controls and must be reused. Pinned Sovol printer.cfg exactly matches the two commissioning factory thermistor curves; pinned Klipper thermistor.py defaults bed pull-up to4700 while vendor hotend specifies11500, which are software reference facts only. Pinned Octopus non-Pro sample explicitly warns against Pro v1.1 and EBB sample is a reference, not complete physical capability evidence. runtime/sv08_mounts.py deliberately supplies a config view symlink, while Store generation_path rejects arbitrary links. Current Store imports Budget, but historical installed Store at8c6f24f parent has no Budget: installation must resolve that concrete API gap without a broad runtime refresh. stage_admin_ui.py currently requires matching whole core closure and excludes a second package, warranting the proposed narrow additive stager. Approval conditions make catalog provenance, coherent CAS/durable publication, reserve accounting, historical API compatibility and real installed journey testable. Draft/provisional inactive output remains usable before physical evidence; no activation, compatibility, printing, release or H05 acceptance is certified. Review context and every file hash were independently recomputed and exactly matched the supplied context.
